# GTA6Info.in — GTA 6 news, guides and fixes for India

> Fan-run GTA 6 companion for players in India. GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) came out on Thursday, 19 November 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; in India it unlocked at 12:00 AM IST. PlayStation Store India lists it at ₹5,999 (Standard) and ₹7,499 (Ultimate). News, spoiler-free guides and fixes are updated every hour, with sources linked on every story.
